title: Users with escrowed stables are charged a penalty if TCR < MCR during the grace period
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  When the redemption cooldown requirement is set, users need to escrow their stables for a certain period before being able to redeem collateral. After the cooldown period, the grace period starts, and users can redeem their collateral. However, if the redemption does not take place before the grace period ends, the user will be charged a penalty fee.
